overloads.semanticRole: Returns the database's default language, the language specified by languageType, or (with the standalone '*' syntax) the host database's language when called from a component.

constraints: The optional * parameter is only useful when the command is called from a component: if passed, returns the language configuration of the host database; if omitted, returns the component database's own language configuration.
When called from a method of the host database, always returns the host database's language configuration regardless of *.
If languageType is omitted, returns the current/default language (Current localization, value 1).
